---
name: Security report (do not use)
about: Security vulnerabilities must not be filed as public issues. This template only points you to the right place.
title: "DO NOT FILE SECURITY ISSUES HERE"
labels: []
assignees: ''
---

**Stop.** Public issues are visible to everyone, including people who would exploit the problem before it is fixed.

Please report security problems privately, following [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/7Mudit/attenuo/blob/main/SECURITY.md):

- GitHub private vulnerability reporting: https://github.com/7Mudit/attenuo/security/advisories/new
- Email: `security@<domain>` (placeholder; use the GitHub form until the domain is set)

You will get an acknowledgement within 72 hours. Authorization bypass, attenuation violations and audit-chain tampering are treated as the highest severity.

If you opened this by mistake and your issue is not security-related, close it and use the bug or feature template instead.
